audit: 2026-09-16 scheduled remote agent (third fire of the day): one 50 question batch across all four modules, published as eight files data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-16_c_<module>_1..2.json, two per module, split only so that each publishing call could carry complete literal content. Split 12 Paediatrics, 12 Obstetrics and Gynaecology, 13 Psychiatry and 13 Medicine; tier mix 24 L3, 21 L4 and 5 L5 with no L1 and no L2, taking the bank to 6592 with all four modules exactly level on 1648. Cell selection: the live matrix before this fire showed Paediatrics and Obstetrics on 1636 and Psychiatry and Medicine on 1635, with L3 deficits against the ideal 50 per cent of 13.75 points in Paediatrics, 13.32 in Obstetrics, 12.51 in Medicine and 11.59 in Psychiatry, and L4 deficits against 45 per cent of 13.15, 12.67, 11.73 and 10.63 respectively, while L5 sat at 5.01 per cent in every module, a deficit of about minus 0.01 points. As on the previous ten fires the strict per question argmax is degenerate: it would pour the whole batch into the single largest deficit cell, Paediatrics L3, and breach the Section 2 requirement that the four modules stay within about 10 of each other. This fire therefore allocated 12/12/13/13, applying the tie break clause toward the lower count modules, which brings all four modules to exactly 1648 and reduces the module spread from 1 to 0. Within each module it followed the ideal tier shape rather than the raw argmax, weighted slightly toward L3 because its deficit leads L4 by roughly 0.6 to 1.0 points everywhere, and held L5 at 5.03 per cent rather than letting it decay. The structural point for the maintainer still stands: because L5 sits at target its deficit can never exceed the 11 to 14 point deficits carried by L3 and L4, so a strict argmax reading will never select an L5 cell and the tier needs an explicit per batch quota if sustained growth is wanted. Audit: valid JSON, zero em-dashes and zero non-ASCII characters, zero banned tokens, every question difficulty 3, 4 or 5, answer-length parity max to min at or under 1.35 on all 50, correct letters exactly 10 per letter A to E after a position rebalancing pass, source_refs all resolving to declared source labels, at least two sources per question with an Australian source first, reference_ranges keys all valid, vitals in fixed order or compressed to within normal limits, data_table values all flat strings, no lead-in guideline leak, no parenthetical qualifier in any correct option, no correct option uniquely carrying a numeral, no weight-based dose arithmetic in any lead-in, explanation.summary 3 to 5 sentences with 3 to 5 key points and a specific pearl on every question. Three defects were found on audit and fixed before publication: a placeholder left in the model field of the aplastic anaemia item; a correct option uniquely carrying a numeral in the pregnancy of unknown location item, corrected by writing a distractor's follow up days as digits; and two invalid reference_ranges keys of ecg in the digoxin and Irukandji items. scripts/dupe_gate.py --new passed on the first run against the 6542 pre-existing questions, but the review band showed three pairs between 0.62 and 0.69 that manual inspection confirmed were substantive duplicates the thresholds did not catch: a nasolacrimal duct obstruction item against sched-0914g-paeds-001, a congenital muscular torticollis item against sched-0914f-pae-002, and a fibromyalgia item against sched-0913b-med-014, each sharing the same correct action and several distractors. All three were replaced outright, with matched topic and difficulty, by physiological femoral anteversion in a four year old, night terrors distinguished from nightmares and sleep related seizures, and angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor cough. The gate was re-run after replacement and returned zero duplicates and, this time, zero review band pairs, with intra-batch self comparison also returning zero. No threshold was altered and the script was not modified. The maintainer should note that the gate's soft review band at 0.62 carried real duplicates on this run and is worth reading rather than skipping. A pre-generation coverage probe screened about 200 candidate topics against the existing bank; the bank is now dense enough that most mainstream topics in all four modules return numerous hits, so this fire selected narrow decision points and vetted candidate subtopic_detail and correct option pairs against the gate's own similarity metric before writing, which caught further overlaps including clozapine gastrointestinal hypomotility, clozapine plasma level monitoring, diagnostic overshadowing in intellectual disability, dopamine agonist impulse control disorder, threadworm, adolescent scoliosis and benign paroxysmal positional vertigo, all of which were discarded pre-writing.
